subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should `sessions.patch` intentionally match `sessions.delete` by rejecting every plugin-runtime mutation of a legacy ownerless session row?
rationale: Exact equality is the established delete boundary and safest isolation rule, but applying it to patch can stop previously working persisted plugin flows; tests cannot choose that upgrade contract.

options.title: Match delete and fail closed
options.body: Adopt exact owner equality for patch, with deployed upgrade proof and an operator recovery path for ownerless rows.

options.title: Migrate ownerless rows first
options.body: Delay ownerless rejection until doctor can assign, repair, or retire legacy plugin session rows safely.

options.title: Preserve ownerless patch access
options.body: Reject foreign owners but retain ownerless access, accepting a weaker patch boundary than delete.

recommendation.title: Match delete and fail closed
recommendation.body: Adopt exact owner equality for patch, with deployed upgrade proof and an operator recovery path for ownerless rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects this person to both the existing exact-owner rule and the projection persistence boundary being extended.
